sentences.en: Do not block any ventilation openings.
The ventilation in the room was bad since all of the windows were closed.
sentences.zh: 由于所有的窗户都关着，房间内的通风很不好。

sentences.en: The machine features some ventilation slots.
sentences.zh: 该机器配备了一些通风孔。

senses.zh: 通风，通风系统；（医）（尤指人工）给肺提供空气；（对意见、问题、抱怨等的）公开讨论（或调查）
